name.en: Casa Norte T12-C Compact 12-Volt Cordless Drill Driver with 3/8-Inch Keyless Chuck
name.pt-BR: Furadeira e Parafusadeira Casa Norte T12-C Compacta 12 V com Mandril sem Chave de 10 mm

description.en: A short, light drill driver for furniture assembly, pilot holes, and everyday fastening in wood or metal. Its compact body reaches between cabinet panels, and the 3/8-inch chuck accepts common household bits.
description.pt-BR: Furadeira e parafusadeira curta e leve para montar móveis, abrir furos-guia e fazer fixações em madeira ou metal. O corpo compacto entra entre painéis de armário, e o mandril de 10 mm aceita brocas comuns.
